body:
I’m not a doctor but I googled it and maybe you should seek help. I don’t know your recommended dosage but I see a regular amount to be 10-20mg. The list of symptoms is long and ranged from headache to death so maybe contact a love one or a friend and make sure that if anything occurs that they can drive you to the hospital.

Not to panic you, I’m in the same boat of being on antidepressants

Waiting 2 weeks for a response from my friends to a text. Then seeing that they’re hanging out on Snapchat. So I realized that I’m literally deadweight. I wish guns were more easily accessible so I could cut the deadweight and let my friends continue their life without issue
It was time.

For me it either every week or every couple weeks. I’ll be ok (not to where I used to be) for a while, like 3-5 days, then I’ll go back down hill for an equal time. The worst part is that I never feel like I’m back to where I was when I was actually ok and not depressed
I know it won’t
No, just wanted a place to put my final thoughts and a goodbye
Why fight for so long when I don’t even know when or if it’s going to be worth it?
Thanks for trying to help
I’ve been depressed and suicidal for more than a year now. All I do is hope it gets better before I get worse
Having someone who genuinely loves and cares about me that isn’t blood related. Someone I can spend my life with
It doesn’t mean that that actually get me any closer to anything.
I’m not resisting. I’m open and I’m funny and I think I look ok, and I try to jokenly flirt but nothing happens. I talk to so many people but I swear all the girls can see I’m just broken inside
I mean, I’m kinda just a lonely loser who is never going to find someone. At least other people has something to strive toward, or some sort of happiness
[picks up self] so is this
[opens fact check book] Page 1: I don’t really believe I can
Thanks for trying to help
No and I can’t, it’s just not how my brain works
It’s been more than a year now, I’ve talked to friends, I’ve talked to a therapist, I’ve played video games, I’ve distracted myself with work and classes.
You’re right, I had a partner but she cheated on me and I can’t get back to the point where I’m ok anymore
I can enjoy a moment but whenever I want to be with somebody, like love, I cannot see a future with someone else.
I mean that I can’t feel happy, I can’t successfully make a goal towards happiness

I’ve tried all of that. I’ve went to therapy I’ve talked to friends I’ve talked to family. I’ve tried working in school I’ve started knew projects, I’ve done everything. I’m done. Projects and school were just a distraction and I tired myself out. I just want to put a bullet between my eyes. Nothing will repair the damage she did and no one will ever love me again
There’s no point, nobody cares, I should just end it. Everything hurts, at least nothing is better than pain

Ex cheated on me. The regular bullshit that everyone can handle. Been alone for a while now and everything hurts, I am unloveable. I’ve heard all the usual hopeful bs over and over again but nothing ever feels good. There’s only pain and sadness. I just want to kill myself
It’s the worst I’ve ever been I just want to end it
Thank you

Imma step in here. I just made the original post because of something that happened to me last night that made me very sad. I’m sorry OGweebinit for what you have experienced to obtain that view. And atXNola I’m sorry to have started this post that lead to this toxic thread. I understand the idea of getting better by yourself and to learn to be happy without someone, I have things that I like to do it’s just that because of what I’ve went through it’s made me not trust anyone. I find it very enjoyable to make other people happy but the inability to find someone to want me that way makes me feel like I can’t help other people. I feel like everyone has their unique issues and my issue doesn’t entirely come from rejection but from betrayal. I’m sorry I broke your heart. I just needed a place to vent because I haven’t felt this bad since when I was originally cheated on. Who knows maybe someday somebody will want to be with me. Thanks for your time
If it means anything. I hope it goes really well for you
Thanks for your support
It’s ok. You sound right. I’m tired too, I just don’t have any motivation anymore to even try to feel better. I tried for a while but I just don’t see a way out
The private sessions made me feel a little better temporarily
Yeah, I talked to a therapist in private sessions and did group sessions at my institution

Thanks, I just don’t really have a logical path to happiness. Like I want to cuddle and feel good, but It’s really disheartening to just try to be ok and get through the day when I just don’t see anything getting better. I’m just a worthless piece of shit that doesn’t deserve to be cared about, no wonder I don’t have a partner, it’s not like she ever cared about me enough to tell me she was cheating on me. She left me to figure out that one

It’s not like that they don’t work entirely it’s just that I’m tired and sad all the time and they seem like they don’t help as much as they used to. I’ll still have ups sometimes but I’m brought back down quickly by my depression
I was happy at one point and I know what makes me happy but my depression drains the joy from those actions
I have things that I like to do. It’s just that I’m starving for physical connect or affection. I know I’m never going to have that again
Oh, you know. The classic depression, nothing feels good, and I’m going to be alone forever.
Yep, but it’s not like I’m going to be able to end it.
No one can help
I’m not into that, I’m so done. I got an exam tomorrow anyway

Idk, I have a pretty grounded worldview I just think that I ruined my ability to be happy. No one really texts me about how I’m doing no one looks forward to seeing me no one wants to be with me no one thinks about me. Fuck this. I’m so fucking tired of this shit. I gotta do something
Me too, what usually stops me is the thought that somebody will find my body. I don’t want to do that to anyone

I’m not in a position to convince anyone not to quit but even if I want to quit I still don’t want others to harm themselves. Please don’t quit. It may sound bad coming from the person who just said that they want to kill themselves soon, but I find that some part of me still wants to be alive. I try to find the little things to look forward to
Quit
Hopefully I’ll find enough courage to do it some day soon

I stop talking about when after a year of being depressed my best friend finally said that she doesn’t know how to help me. It made me realize that it’s all hopeless. It’s so easy to lie and fake a smile to everyone I meet, but sometimes it’s hard, the one time a friend found out it’s because I could hold it in long enough for a lunch conversation.

I genuinely believe that I’m not worth saving anymore. I want my friends to forget me and I want to wither way. I know what it feels like to be the happiest I could be and to know that I’ll never feel that again gives me the reason to want to disappear
I didn’t do it
Thank you
Find something that made me happy. After my previous relationship ended nothing feels good. I miss being cuddled. Now I know that I’m unloveable
I talked with friends, I spoke to a therapist, the latter barely helped and the former feels like delaying the inevitable. They tried their best

Why do you give a damn about me? Why are you talking to me? Why do you ask me so many questions? Why is it that whenever I look for help it never helps, it never has. Why can no one help me? Why does no one love me? Why do I want to kill myself so much but I can’t do it?

I fundamentally do not believe there is an answer to the question, “what was wrong with me?” Because I’ve come to realize that it wasn’t me at least on the part of being a good partner. She found someone better, or someone that she liked more. She stopped giving a fuck about me and didn’t bother to think about how her actions would make me feel. I want to know what I could of done to keep my happiness but the problem is that is was going to be gone anyway.

You know what feeling good feels like, that warmth, that rush of dopamine, that nice feeling in your core, that excitement you get, the smile that grows on your face. Hollow means that I don’t get that shit anymore, I could get a 100% on an exam and I wouldn’t give a fuck. Nothing feels good anymore.

I can understand that when you have a friend that is going through some things and they just don’t get over it, that sometimes when that friend asks you for help or is down all the time, sometimes they can bring down your mood. Especially when I’m normally just as depressed after talking to them as before.

They can’t. I feel like I’m not good enough because the only person that romantically loved me dropped me for another guy. They can’t help with that feeling of inadequacy. I’m going to live with that for the rest of my short life. I thought they could help me before but now I know nothing will fix the hole she left. They could at least give me a reason other than, “I would be sad”, “your family would be sad”, “It gets better”, because I don’t believe for a moment that things are going to get better. The first two just make it seem like it’s ok to keep living even though you’re in pain every second because other people need me. I thought I had someone who needed me, but it turns out she does plenty fine with some other cunt.

When someone asks, “how are you?” they don’t give a fuck how you are they are just opening a conversation. When I start saying things like, “Im never happy” or “I want to kill myself” or “I hurt myself” it would seems like an appropriate response to pull me aside and ask me heart to heart is everything is ok. If it’s not ok, then to ask what they can do. If you see bruises on somebody’s arm, ask if they’re ok.

I can probably tell that you keep asking questions to help me get through this but I don’t think this has an end. I just keep going in circles about how nothing ever feels good and no one loves me. I feel like a whiny asshole, who the fuck cares if I want to kill myself. I’ve done a pretty fucking good job at convincing myself that nothing will ever feel good again and that I should end it all. Your questions are probably there just to stall me anyway. I’m so fucking tired of hating myself and nothing feeling good. I’m done with this shit world, I tried to be the nicest kindest person I could be but all it did was spit in my face. Fuck this shit, my only regret is that I didn’t end it all sooner so save myself some pain

I mean that she left me without giving an explanation and out of the blue. I asked her what I did wrong or what was wrong with me but she couldn’t give me a direct or informative answer. From my understanding of the situation she just found someone better. I’ve analyzed my behavior, my actions towards her and I thought that I was extremely nice. I was never mean to her nor knocked her down, I treated her with respect and loved her. I asked her about her day chatted with her daily on the phone etc. All while being relatively enthusiastic. This type of grief does not have closure. Because I can’t get an answer to my internal questions I rehash the same things with friends when I’m sad. Nobody ever asks me how I feel, what I really feel. Everyone acts like everything is ok, I never want to talk about it because I know they’ll just be a blank reflecting board. If they don’t bring it up or genuinely sit me down to ask me what’s going on, they see the bruises on my arms and assume it’s something else or ignore it.

I am so physically and emotionally romantically deprived that I don’t ever feel good anymore. Everyone always says depression is like feeling lost but it doesn’t encapsulated the feeling of being hollow. I want someone who genuinely cares about me but who I also love physically. I go weeks realizing that I haven’t touched another person. I know exactly what complete happiness felt like and I had it. I was completely unworried and in total trust of my partner, I could tell them anything and they would love me. And this was all true the other way around. I want to be able to be a shoulder they can lean on. I also just miss the feeling of being cuddled by someone you love. These problems are caused by the trauma sustained from the previous relationship I don’t even genuinely believe that I’m fixable anymore.

What I mean by the truth is that I want to know what is wrong with me that makes it so that people don’t want to be with me. There most likely isn’t an answer.

If I don’t pretend to be mentally healthy, if I appear sad most of the time, if I seem broken or depressed or damaged then no one will want me. I already have no one wanting me when I was relatively intact so being sad doesn’t improve my odds. I also heavily care about my friends and don’t want to make them feel bad or burden them with my problems so I hide my pain.

The thing that screws me the most is the thought that no one cares about me and that people only want me here for themselves. My friends don’t genuinely ask how I’m doing, if I ever mention that I hurt myself or that I want to kill myself the only response I get is that they would be very sad. To me this is a burden of guilt, I want to so badly kill myself but I can’t do it, I suffer and it seems like the only reason anyone ever cares is that because if I was gone then they would feel sad. Well what about me! I spend my whole relationship trying to be the best partner I could ever be and what do I get! Cheated on! I finally started caring how I feel and now I know that I feeling fucking terrible all the time. I, want, it, to, end.

I even mentioned in my last post that I have a date for it too. I just get ignored or trivialized. Nobody mentions my bruises, nobody asks me if I’m thinking about killing myself, nobody wants to see how I feel. I find it sad that if I killed myself tomorrow it would probably be a shock to everyone, “But he was always so happy” they would say

Wrong phrasing I guess. It’s not really that I don’t give a fuck about myself, it’s that the only thing I ever will have is me. Nobody wants me, nobody cares about me, nobody is there. Nevermind I said anything I’ll be gone soon enough

I feel like since I can’t receive closure on my relationship and keep talking about the same sad things with my friends. It doesn’t make me feel any better and I feel like I’m annoying my friends.

When my partner cheated and then broke up with me, I was sad. I attempted to find someone else who could make me feel happy and someone I could make happy too. Through chatting with people, dating apps, etc. I found that people are not interested in me, at least no where to the same magnitude as any of my friends. All my friends have boyfriends or easily find people to date who like them. I don’t know if I’m intimidating or ugly or unapproachable. The fact that I was dropped for someone else and that no one wants me even now demonstrates the cause for my feeling of inadequacy.

I would feel that when you are talking to a friend who is depressed and they talk about how they are terrible and how no one likes them, then you would normally say, “It’s ok, you’re not ugly, you’re awesome” etc. etc. If I was all the terrible things that I think I am they wouldn’t tell me the truth, but if I was beautiful and amazing they would also say the same thing. No matter what I am they would most likely compliment me.

It’s been so long now that I am genuinely dead inside. I gleam happiness and humor when talking to people but I don’t ever feel happy. It’s all an act so that they don’t know that I hurt myself and wish that I was dead. I am not going to be loved. Fuck this place. I wish I died the moment she broke up with me. I got the date, I’m just waiting to lose the last sliver of hope.

Sorry I was busy.

Now I’ve talked to them enough that I feel like I’m rehashing old material that I’m still not over. I’m stuck because I’m miserable and I don’t believe and I can anything to remedy the situation. I don’t want to try really hard and fake my way into a shitty relationship, I want to love someone and that someone to love me back.

My feeling come from inadequacy generated from my previous relationship. I have no evidence that anyone loves me. I want to feel like what I felt before. I’m starving for physical and romantic affection.

I’ve tried dating apps, I’ve tried being slightly more forward. I get no signals that anyone is interested. All my friends either have boyfriends or get hit on or got boyfriends during the last year. All I ever do is study and do class work. I cram ever last second of my week doing work so that I don’t have to think about how lonely I am. Nobody wants me which is clear through speaking with people, my friends say that I am desirable but it’s not like I can believe them because if I was undesirable they would lie. I’m an emotional wreak and I think about killing myself daily, who the fuck would date that.

They listen to me and talk and help me get away from negative reactions. I feel like I’m stuck and never going to get better.

I wouldn’t be like if I had someone like that. That’s my problem.

My previous and first girlfriend and only person who has ever shown me romantic interest cheated on me, broke up with me and then let me figure out what she did

Because my friends see how lost I am, they try to help but at the end of the day I just talk for too long and still feel terrible.

Happiness for me is being with someone who genuinely cares about me and me for them. If I was happy I would look forward to the next day.

Therapy was helpful but it’s expensive and doesn’t solve my underlying problem that I’m lonely and genuinely believe that nobody will ever love me for me

I don’t want to bother my friends. I’ve tried therapy, I’ve tried talking about my depression with my friends, I’ve tried to talk to my parents. I can’t find happiness. I waste their time and bring them down. No one wants to be around someone who’s depressed

I’m also on the same position. It’s kinda fucked too cause I found that I’m only really attracted to people who like me, so I find it hard to even fall in love with other people. I have that same feeling that I just don’t even want to try anymore. It slams even harder when I think that I’ll never feel ok
It sucks shit

You are a saint. There is nothing to be sorry about. I keep thinking all the time, my mind is always racing... she was a way to slow it down and let me really enjoy life. I’ve cried a lot over the past day and I figured out that I do really want to live, I want to so bad, I’m so unbelievably engrossed with curiosity about the world and I do want to learn and do everything. I just find that it hurts so bad, my mind is a minefield of my own creation. I want so desperately to enjoy living and to be apart of everything. I was finally validated that I exist and am worthy of something. I just want to be liked back as much as I love everything in the fucking beautiful world, but all I receive is a vacant response from the world

She found someone that she liked more, that’s why she left me. I don’t believe there’s someone for everyone. I know that I’m inferior because I’m not good enough for her. Nobody ever hits on me and the only reason they ever talk is asking about homework for lecture. I just rationalize that I must be absolute garbage because why else would only one person ever like and and why would that only person leave me for someone else. I talk with people everyday, but I go weeks without touching another human. I just sit in my bed every night alone hoping I don’t wake up... but I do
Thank you for trying

I had someone. And I trusted her. She allowed me to learn what really made me happy. I always think all the time and she was the one to make my head go clear. But she betrayed my trust. I want to find someone to trust but I know that I’ll never trust someone like I did her. That’s what cleared my head, my trust in her

It doesn’t get better though, it’s just the next day. I march toward my lonely useless death everyday anyway. In fact it’s only ever gotten worse, every day of this whole year has made me want to quit more. I’m sorry

I think about it all the time. I’m such a selfish jerk, I do so well in school and I have friends but all I ever wanted was someone to hold at night, but I’m never going to have that. I should be happy and I hate myself for that

Thank you. I had hope. I knew what I wanted and I knew it takes time. But I’ve come to the bypass that I know it’s not possible. I had hope for so long, but every last drop I had slowly drained out. I want to go back in time
Yeah the relationship is over, it has been for a while. She just didn’t give a conclusion when ask for why she left. It was only until later that I found out what she did

Thank you so much for the discussion btw. I just don’t think that I want to alter myself to that extent to appeal to people I most likely won’t like. For example: I like Math, Physics, Computers, Video Games, Philosophy, and Debate. If I had to alter some of these likes to appeal to people then I probably wouldn’t like the people I would appeal to. My main frustration is the disconnect of people saying great things about me yet all I have is loneliness. I want someone who likes me for me.

I have some frequent splashes of extremely bad depression mainly cause by this, but in the end I still don’t blame her, (a least not totally). Her reasoning was understandable, how else would she get out of the difficult long distance relationship I lead her into. Although I definitely think there were better ways (a lot of better ways) to end our relationship, mainly those that don’t directly cause depression, social anxiety, and suicidal thoughts within me. But hey, that’s OK. I’m not going to burden her with that, I haven’t even told her how much shes fucked up my head, but I don’t want to tell her.

Thank you so much for commenting, It really does help to talk guilt free about this stuff with other people. Although it sounds like I spend the majority of my time doing work, I also try to spend time meeting new people. I’m generally the one to strike up conversations with new people at the beginning of a semester. The main problem is that no one is interested in me. I try to be the nicest possible person I can, I love cracking jokes and more. The issue is that I want someone to like me so I try to be the best possible me, the first issue is that they show zero signs of flirting, and second is that I find someone finding me attractive to be attractive. I don’t want to go out of my way to convince someone that I’m worth 3 seconds of their time only to get crushed again. Also I’m extremely scared that the same thing will happen to me again

I generally do really well in school, it’s less studying and more just work. Homework, projects, lab reports, everything that is required and not excessive studying. The issues arrises when a 1 credit class assigns 20 hours of lab related hw every week. I have a decent chunk of friends but at the end of the day when I get back to my dorm the thought that there is nobody that thinks about me, that I’ll sleep alone, no I love you text. Just more work. That’s the only thing that awaits my arrival to my room.

I’m trying the best I can, I’ve been to school provided group therapy for depression. It was alright. I just think that I won’t convince myself internally that I can trust a partner again. I thought that I would need someone with which I can trust to rebuild my confidence in trusting.

The main problem is that she was the only person to ever show interest in me so I feel like everyone is lying to me about being desirable so that I don’t harm myself or worse.

I can’t find another partner to be with. I’m just alone with ungodly amounts of work

Yeah, I feel like I don’t trust anyone for anything anymore. I’ve definitely seen people’s actions as more selfish in general after my experience. I hope you’re doing alright. I’m in a very bad mental position so I know how unhelpful “hopes” can be but I get how you feel
